human_constraints: Preserve ALL old models and results; no adoption, deployment or production switch without subsequent user decision.
hypothesis: Evidence-specific changes and a learned arbitration head can reduce induced errors, harmful withdrawals and Top3 substitution losses while preserving complementary detection.
main_event: Next adjacent official trading session close limit-up; exact-cent 10% unadjusted price corroborated by valid archived promotion target. Missing qualification remains UNKNOWN.
secondary_event: Intraday touch, separate from close limit-up.
baseline: Codex independent; Gemini independent is a prespecified peer reference.
references: Old formal BASE if saved and same-pool available

selection.rule: Lowest SHA256(seed:stratum:date), excluding every date in previous 12-day sample; complete archived relay pool, no label/score/performance/size filter.

training.rows: all pre-September old rows with strict_close known; unknown labels retained in exclusions
training.chronology: Every included training target_date strictly before every test signal date.
training.weights: Each known training row receives (known rows / training days) / known rows on its day; mean sample weight is one, dates have equal total weight.
training.decision: YES iff raw score > 0.5; NO otherwise, except both reviewers UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN.
training.ranking: Raw learned score descending, then equal average of both independent full-pool ranks, then fixed anonymous-ID hash. No forced shape slots.
training.probability: Uncalibrated internal score, never advertised as validated event probability.

sequence: Both reviewers independently write all rows and full rank before viewing the other.
Codex proposes each change using concrete evidence and counterevidence.
Gemini audits or counters each proposal once.
Codex binds acceptance/rejection with reasons; no forced consensus.
Freeze all rows, Top3, head output and all discussion hashes; only then reveal.
consultation.top3_change: Name entrants and displaced stocks, compare both on identical available evidence. UNKNOWN withdrawal requires its own reason and opportunity cost.
consultation.unresolved: Preserve Codex baseline call and explicitly record unresolved disagreement; do not silently force UNKNOWN or YES.
prohibited_shortcuts: No theme, queue or money-flow invention
No one-field missingness ban on all predictions

metrics: Complete Top3 hits, misses and unknown slots
Judged Accuracy, coverage, Precision, full Recall, F1
success_rule: Diagnostic candidate only if complete Top3 confirmed hits and full-known correct fraction both exceed Codex independent; Precision and non-one-price F1 not lower. Unknown labels and coverage reported separately. Even a diagnostic win is not stable/forward proof and never permits automatic adoption.
end_rule: One fit and one reveal; no effect-driven parameter change, date replacement or refit. If the actual Gemini service remains unavailable, do not claim joint completion and do not reveal the new test.
limits: Previously researched historical domain and late-acquired sources: NOT independently certified blind or genuine forward evidence.
No qualified historical theme/forum/announcement text: price-volume/emotion/competition scope only.
Only 8 available old training days; small fit may be unstable, all same-date stocks correlated.
September-only holdout is not cross-cycle validation; retain pool/survivor and supplier biases.
No trading fills, fees or returns are inferred from this event-prediction experiment.
